charter: FULL_PROJECT_AUDIT.md §4 (Layering, state ownership, coupling, error boundaries, store contracts)
question: Is it well-bounded? Can a contributor test/change one layer without understanding all layers?
verdict: Yes. decompiler/transpiler/runtime are cleanly bounded and node-testable; engine now isolated via injected DebuggerStore, hostStack + MovieClip.__construct stack, and generation-guarded AssetCache; App owns an isolated DebuggerStore via DebuggerProvider and no longer shares the global singleton. ProjectResult→AS2Program→Player one-way contract holds, with Map<string,Callbacks> replacing the former single-slot. No caveats; 9 ARCH now Fixed (5 Info/Low kept as documented debt).

ioBoundary: none — caller supplies bytes/XML; DecompressionStream('deflate') only for CWS inflates
errorBoundary: parseTags throws on truncated; parseSwfXml surfaces parsererror; parseSwfBinary throws ZWS; per-tag try/catch -> warnings

findings.evidence: selectSwf swaps cacheRef+doc atomically; buildPackage onChange->tick bridges assets<->cache but cache.load* async may resolve after activeSwfIndex switched
findings.disposition: Fixed — cacheGenerationRef token in App; buildPackage captures generation and finish() checks before setTick; installPackages/selectSwf bump generation; New folder also bumps

findings.evidence: 5 circulars (runtime actor, flash context/events, flash player/context, as2 player/builtins, gameServerStub/mockNetwork), 1 orphan main.tsx
findings.disposition: Fixed (type-only) — constants.ts extracts DEPTH_OFFSET/NODE/TWIPS/nodeOf, builtins now import type DisplayNode only; madge 5 reports are import-type false positives, no runtime value cycle on decompiler→transpiler→runtime seam

findings.evidence: globalDebugger singleton holds one DebuggerCallbacks; last useEffect to mount wins, so F5 Continue from Code Inspector could resume wrong player after pausing (only one workspace mounted at a time in App:workspace, so low live repro, but Popout portals duplicate)
findings.disposition: Fixed — Map<string,DebuggerCallbacks>+activeId, App isolated store via createDebuggerStore(), As2/Flash register as 'as2'/'flash' and pass debugger: dbg to players; forEachCallback respects activeId

findings.evidence: Flash constructs clip before class new Ctor() body via MovieClip.__construct=build hook; second AS2Player in same jsdom can clobber host/__construct between ticks
findings.disposition: Fixed — hostStack + uninstallHost + resetRuntime clears, MovieClip/Button/TextField.__construct is now stack with _clearConstructStack, AS2Player stores _host and dbg injection, dispose clears tintCache + construct stacks

findings.disposition: Keep (reasoned debt) — no new any, AS2Clip {[key:string]:any} by spec; already has eslint-disable header, tsc 0

findings.evidence: DebuggerStore.emit() loops [...listeners] with no try/catch; DebugPanel:evaluateWatch(new Function) catches user errors but listener throw would unwind players
findings.disposition: Fixed — DebuggerStore.emit wraps each listener in try/catch, forEachCallback guards each onContinue/onStep* call

findings.evidence: 4 levels deep; TimelineView+Inspector both derive buildWorkbenchTimelineMetadata(doc,project) memo independently; one App at a time so store adds no reuse
findings.disposition: Keep — prop drilling intentionally kept for doc/cache/project (one App at a time); DebuggerProvider is the one scoped Context and now isolated
